record_title: All-characteristic character rank formula for graphical groups
provenance: The theorem is proved in RESULT.md from the central-extension structure of graphical groups and a self-contained twisted-group-algebra lemma; scientific sources are listed in source_urls.
limitations: The general formula reduces character enumeration to alternating-matrix rank counts but does not establish polynomiality in q for arbitrary graphs. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; an equivalent older formulation in general class-two or projective-representation terminology remains a residual risk.
